main_body: Small treasure chest/crate about 15 rows tall: an orange banded lid with corner rivets, a dark gap, a yellow and black checker strip, and a dark base.
top_band: Rows 1-3 form an orange gradient (L 111, 141, 169) that could read as a lid top. Row 4 is a dark band (L 111), and rows 5-7 are light (L 202, 169, 202). The lid-top candidate is darker than the face below it, so no lighter horizontal surface sits above the front.
evidence: The column reads as stacked horizontal planks and bands seen face-on. The top candidate (rows 1-3) is darker than the 'face' (rows 5-7), which is the reverse of a lit horizontal surface. No light front-edge line separates a top from the front, and no eave shadow sits under the lid (row 4 is only a plank seam). The corner rivets and the checker strip are painted flat on the face. This matches the red front-elevation drawing in the guide, so it fails.

style.evidence: The orange wood ramp has about 5 steps (L 80, 111, 141, 169, 202) plus a yellow accent, with no flat 5x5 fills. Distinct colours total 12 against 38-40 in the references, and median colours per tile is 12 against 17-20, so it is thinner than both. The upper outline is a tinted dark brown (#3a1808), but the lower rows use a neutral blue-black (#20202a), so the outline is mixed. Wood grain and plank texture are minimal: the planks are just horizontal bands. Beside the references it looks flatter and more sticker-like, so it fails.
